## Operators and array functions

# BigQuery's shifts drop the bits shifted out and fill with zeros, even for negative values.
SELECT 1 << 63
=> "-9223372036854775808"

SELECT 3 << 62
=> "-4611686018427387904"

SELECT -8 >> 1
=> "9223372036854775804"

SELECT 1 << 64
=> "0"

SELECT 8 >> 2
=> "2"

SELECT CAST(NULL AS INT64) << 1
=> null

# Bitwise operators on BYTES work byte by byte, and shifts move bits across the whole sequence
# and keep its length, as third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/operators.md defines
# them; the shifts are cases of GoogleSQL's compliance test data.
SELECT TO_HEX(~b'\x01\x23\x45\x67\xef\xaa')
=> "fedcba981055"

SELECT TO_HEX(~b'')
=> ""

SELECT ~CAST(NULL AS BYTES)
=> null

SELECT TO_HEX(b'\x00\xff' & b'\xff\x00')
=> "0000"

SELECT TO_HEX(b'\x00\xff' | b'\xff\x00')
=> "ffff"

SELECT TO_HEX(b'\x00\xff' ^ b'\xff\x00')
=> "ffff"

SELECT TO_HEX(b'\xaa\xaa' ^ b'\xff\xaa')
=> "5500"

SELECT TO_HEX(b'' & b'')
=> ""

SELECT b'foo' & CAST(NULL AS BYTES)
=> null

# Binary operators on BYTES of different lengths fail.
SELECT b'' | b'\xff'
=> error:

SELECT TO_HEX(b'\xfe\xdc\xba\x98\x76' << 17)
=> "7530ec0000"

SELECT TO_HEX(b'\xfe\xdc\xba\x98\x76' >> 1)
=> "7f6e5d4c3b"

SELECT TO_HEX(b'\xfe\xdc\xba\x98\x76' >> 41)
=> "0000000000"

SELECT b'foo' << CAST(NULL AS INT64)
=> null

SELECT b'foo' >> -1
=> error:

SELECT 1 IS DISTINCT FROM NULL
=> "true"

SELECT NULL IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULL
=> "true"

SELECT 2 IN UNNEST([1, 2])
=> "true"

SELECT 3 IN UNNEST([1, NULL])
=> null

SELECT NULL IN UNNEST([1])
=> null

SELECT 1 IN UNNEST(CAST([] AS ARRAY<INT64>))
=> "false"

# BigQuery returns a NULL array in a query result as an empty one.
SELECT CAST(NULL AS ARRAY<INT64>)
=> []

SELECT 1 IN UNNEST(CAST(NULL AS ARRAY<INT64>))
=> "false"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_CONCAT(['a'], ['b'], ['c']), ',')
=> "a,b,c"

SELECT ARRAY_CONCAT(['a'], CAST(NULL AS ARRAY<STRING>)) IS NULL
=> "true"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_REVERSE(['a', 'b']), ',')
=> "b,a"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(['a', 'b'], NULL)
=> null

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(['a', 'b'], ',', NULL)
=> null

# The delimiter and NULL text need not be constants; NULL elements and their preceding delimiter
# are omitted without NULL text:
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/array_functions.md
SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(a, d) FROM (SELECT ['coffee', NULL, 'tea'] AS a, '--' AS d)
=> "coffee--tea"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(a, d, n) FROM (SELECT ['coffee', 'tea', 'milk', NULL] AS a, '--' AS d, 'MISSING' AS n)
=> "coffee--tea--milk--MISSING"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(a, d) FROM (SELECT [b'prefix', b'middle', b'suffix', b'\x00'] AS a, b'--' AS d)
=> "cHJlZml4LS1taWRkbGUtLXN1ZmZpeC0tAA=="

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(a, d) FROM (SELECT [b'coffee', NULL, b'tea'] AS a, b'--' AS d)
=> "Y29mZmVlLS10ZWE="

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(a, d, n) FROM (SELECT [b'cake', b'pie', NULL] AS a, b'--' AS d, b'MISSING' AS n)
=> "Y2FrZS0tcGllLS1NSVNTSU5H"

SELECT ARRAY_FIRST([4, 5])
=> "4"

SELECT ARRAY_LAST([4, 5])
=> "5"

SELECT IF(TRUE, 1, ERROR('boom'))
=> "1"

SELECT ROUND(1.25, 1)
=> "1.3"

SELECT ROUND(-2.5)
=> "-3.0"

# Mathematical functions return NULL for a NULL argument:
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/mathematical_functions.md
SELECT ROUND(x, CAST(NULL AS INT64)) FROM UNNEST([1.25]) x
=> null

SELECT ROUND(x, digits) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1.25 AS x, CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS digits)])
=> null

SELECT ROUND(NUMERIC '2.5', 0, 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN') = NUMERIC '2'
=> "true"

SELECT ROUND(NUMERIC '-3.5', 0, 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN') = NUMERIC '-4'
=> "true"

SELECT ROUND(NUMERIC '1.25', 1, 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN') = NUMERIC '1.2'
=> "true"

SELECT ROUND(NUMERIC '1.251', 1, 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN') = NUMERIC '1.3'
=> "true"

SELECT ROUND(NUMERIC '150', -2, 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN') = NUMERIC '200'
=> "true"

SELECT ROUND(NUMERIC '12345678901234567890.25', 1, 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN') = NUMERIC '12345678901234567890.2'
=> "true"

SELECT ROUND(BIGNUMERIC '0.5', 0, 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN') = BIGNUMERIC '0'
=> "true"

SELECT ROUND(NUMERIC '2.5', 0, 'ROUND_HALF_AWAY_FROM_ZERO') = NUMERIC '3'
=> "true"

SELECT LPAD('a', 3)
=> "  a"

SELECT RPAD('a', 3, 'xy')
=> "axy"

SELECT LPAD('abc', 2)
=> "ab"

SELECT 1 << -1
=> error:

SELECT ARRAY_FIRST(CAST([] AS ARRAY<INT64>))
=> error:

# BigQuery groups by ARRAYs, though it neither compares nor orders them.
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([1, 2] AS a), STRUCT([1, 2] AS a)]) GROUP BY a
=> "2"

# A query can use ARRAYs with NULL elements that its result does not return.
SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH([1, NULL])
=> "2"
